title: leisurecraftinc.com
description: As of December 31, 2016, the amount owed by a shareholder to Leisure Craft Inc. had reached USD 1,890,814—34.72% of the company’s total assets. This item increased by USD 401,828 over the year. In the same reporting period, the company reported USD 16,499,133 in revenue and USD 599,518 in net income.
